text: Beta Utensili and the Beta Group are a Ciceri family company led by Roberto Ciceri, the founder's great-grandson (President and CEO); since 2016 the Italian investment company TIP has been a co-shareholder alongside him.
short: Beta is a Ciceri family company, with TIP as co-shareholder since 2016.

source.name: Beta Utensili: 100 years of Beta (group history)
source.quote: Alongside Roberto Ciceri, the founder's great-grandson, came the Italian company TIP, while Beta continued to grow thanks to new and innovative products

additionalSources.name: Beta Utensili: Company profile
additionalSources.quote: In a century of history the company has grown thanks to the entrepreneurial spirit of the Ciceri family, culminating in the foundation of Beta Group
additionalSources.note: The same page attributes its lead paragraph to 'Roberto Ciceri, President and CEO'.
